*   **Max Resolution:** The largest cell size (smallest depth) not to overpass.
Prevents infinite subdivision loops caused by subtractive tools creating discontinuities.
Reverse actions cannot simply subtract the tool value.
*   **Infinite Subdivision:** Subtractive tools can create discontinuities.
*   **Shared Vertex Updates:** When subdividing, shared vertices between adjacent cells must be updated only once.
*   **Undo Mechanism:** Undo is treated as a special Action.
Undo files store modified vertex addresses (not memory pointers, as vertices may be reallocated).
*   **Time Complexity:** Depends on the number of active cells and vertices.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Higher than fixed-resolution grids for sparse details due to hierarchy overhead, but lower than uniform high-resolution grids.
